items.title: Singapore MPA imposes stricter checks on vessels with PSC detentions
items.content_text: The Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore has announced enhanced Port State Control inspections targeting vessels with prior detention records. The crackdown follows a spike in deficiencies reported at Jurong Port and Pasir Panjang Terminal.

items.title: Shadow fleet tanker OCEAN NAVIGATOR flagged in straits of Malacca
items.content_text: A vessel identified as part of the shadow fleet was tracked transiting Singapore waters. Authorities at Changi Terminal have been alerted.

items.title: Bunker fuel demand surges at Jurong Island despite refinery constraints
items.content_text: Bunker fuel demand at Jurong Island has increased sharply this quarter. Port agents are reporting longer wait times at bunkering anchorages near Raffles Marina.
